parameters.jsCode:
// Fail the WF06 execution when a Switch node cannot determine a valid route.

const input = $json ?? {};

const routeSnapshot = {
  next_action:
    input.next_action ?? null,

  operation_type:
    input.operation_type ?? null,

  finalization_route:
    input.finalization_route ?? null,

  calendar_search_route:
    input.calendar_search_route ?? null,

  team_notification_search_route:
    input.team_notification_search_route ?? null,

  team_notification_delivery_route:
    input.team_notification_delivery_route ?? null,

  case_id:
    input.case_id ?? null,

  correlation_id:
    input.correlation_id ?? null,

  operation_id:
    input.operation_id ?? null,
};

throw new Error(
  `WF06 reached an unexpected routing fallback: ${JSON.stringify(routeSnapshot)}`,
);
